rows.grounds: compound numeral saptāṣṭaṣaṭśatena fused with indeclinable atha
tāmreṇa fused with ādhārakaḥ by sandhi

items.question: What copper measure constitutes the support designated for the lord?
premises: A specific numerical measure is prescribed
Copper is specified as the material
The support belongs to the lord
items.inference: The lord's support is to be made of copper according to the stated measure
uncertainties: The exact interpretation of the numeral sequence saptāṣṭaṣaṭa as seven-eight-six is inferred from the legacy hint
items.plain_english: Then, with seven hundred and eighty-six, the support for the Lord is to be made of copper.
